intro: We learned to code the hard way — late nights, free tutorials and a lot of broken layouts. Along the way we realised the best products come from two people who trust each other enough to say “this isn’t good enough yet.”

That trust is how PSBM Labs runs today: shared responsibility for every release, honest status updates, and support that doesn’t end at launch. Angkan Barai, Prothes’s younger brother, keeps our shipped products stable after release.
Working from Barisal, we want to show that world-class apps and software can be built by a small, dedicated team in Bangladesh.

chapters.title: Two paths into web development
chapters.text: Prothes and Shreyasi begin learning and building websites on their own — HTML, CSS and JavaScript first, using free resources like FreeCodeCamp and W3Schools.

chapters.title: From websites to full-stack
chapters.text: Shreyasi moves into full-stack development and WordPress; Prothes grows into WordPress, databases and Android development.

chapters.title: Prothes completes B.Sc in CSE
chapters.text: Software engineering becomes his full-time focus, including Android apps and AI projects. Shreyasi continues her B.Sc in CSE at BSMRSTU.

chapters.title: First products go live
chapters.text: Setu POS, Krishi Bazar and Notun Khata ship for small businesses in and around Barisal.

chapters.title: PSBM Labs is formed
chapters.text: The two practices combine into one studio, with Angkan Barai joining as primary maintainer.

faq: PSBM Labs was founded by Prothes Barai and Shreyasi Madhu, a husband-and-wife team of software engineers based in Barisal, Bangladesh. Angkan Barai is co-founder and primary maintainer.
Why does a married couple running a studio help clients?
Every build gets two independent technical perspectives, shared accountability and no account managers in between — the engineers who scope your project are the ones who build and support it.
What does each founder focus on?
Prothes leads app and software development (Flutter, Kotlin, Firebase, databases, WordPress). Shreyasi focuses on full-stack web, WordPress, Django and SEO.
Barisal, Bangladesh. We work with clients across Bangladesh and internationally, mostly over email and video calls.
